correctness.rationale: The event is occupation of any missing matching edge, not return to the initial edge. Sign flips within parts fix the initial state and give one normalized even cross-state per pair of parts. Counting hops gives blocks 0, 2R, 2R^T, 2(R^TR−2I), with R the unsigned K_m incidence. The squared singular values of R are 2m−2 and m−2. Subtracting (q−2)I in each two-state channel gives a traceless square (q²+4)I and transition probability F_q; the initial squared weights are 1/m and (m−1)/m. The sine bound and saturation of the second channel at the stated time squeeze the scaled supremum to 4, without assuming simultaneous phase alignment. The classical rates across the partition are 4(m−1) out and 2 in; hence the decay rate is 4m−2 and its product with the observation time tends to 2π. This also checks the smallest admitted m=3, t=0 and unit-per-hop normalization.
